about: Origin, licence and review status of every tracked file, by path pattern. The first entry whose pattern matches a path applies ('dir/**' = everything under dir; other patterns are fnmatch, and a pattern without '/' matches top-level files only). tools/ip_audit.py checks that every tracked file matches an entry and that no release ships a file whose status is 'unresolved'. Policy: IP_POLICY.md.

statuses.reviewed: origin and licence recorded; nothing open
statuses.needs-review: origin recorded; an open question (see issue / note) to settle before the release that ships it
statuses.unresolved: origin or rights unknown: blocks any release that ships it
